premises.text: Priorities come from inbox, mind, and meetings and must be captured in one place to decide well
premises.evidence_span: your inbox has priorities, but so do they come out of your mind, and they come out of meetings. You have to get them all in one place

premises.text: Email clients alone and task managers alone cannot solve priority management
premises.evidence_span: email clients have not been able to solve this problem alone, and task managers have not been able to solve this problem alone

premises.text: The Handle habit requires capture, triage, plan, and do until important work is complete
premises.evidence_span: We call this the handle habit

premises.text: A priority engine with mobile capture and a keyboard handlebar enables fast email and priority triage
premises.evidence_span: we've created a unique element we call the handlebar

premises.text: An importance-ordered priority list with calendar blocking and task-linked context supports focused execution without context switching
premises.evidence_span: Handle's priority list is ordered by importance with must dos at the top

value.text: Getting the must-do priorities done and doing what feels most important
value.evidence_span: getting all the must do things you have to do done that day

causal_links.evidence_span: We call this the handle habit
getting all the must do things you have to do done that day

notes: Demo command list (archive, unsubscribe, push to reader, etc.) folded into handlebar triage (§4.1(5)). Family/dinner disruption language treated as value outcome, not premises. Bio/Menlo credentials excluded.
